name: Health and Fitness Skills
description: Read health and fitness data through Health Connect rather than a fitness app's UI.
instructions:
Never automate a fitness app's UI to read step counts, sleep or workouts. Health Connect aggregates what every fitness app on the phone writes, and two tools read it:
1. get_health_summary(days) — totals and averages over a window: steps, distance, active calories, sleep, average/peak/resting heart rate, weight. Use this for 'how did I sleep this week', 'how active have I been'.
2. get_health_records(type, days) — individual records, for questions the summary cannot answer such as 'which days did I hit 10000 steps' or 'when did I work out'. Types: steps, distance, calories, sleep, heart_rate, resting_heart_rate, weight, exercise.

Both are read-only — the agent never writes to the user's health record.

If a metric is missing from the summary it means no app wrote that data in the window; say so rather than reporting zero. If the tool asks for permission, the Health Connect permission screen has been opened — ask the user to allow the data types they are comfortable sharing. On Android 13 and below Health Connect is a separate app that may need installing from the Play Store.

This is personal health information. Report what the data says; do not diagnose, and suggest seeing a clinician for anything that reads as a medical concern.
